snippet.query: What are BYOD benefits, risks and best practices?
snippet.exactText: Bring your own device (BYOD) allows employees to use personal devices for approved work. Its benefits include device choice and potentially lower hardware spending; its risks include data exposure, privacy concerns and support complexity. BYOD best practices define eligible roles, access controls, management boundaries, funding and an exit process before employees enroll.
